summary: The Streaming Data Engineer builds real-time data pipelines and streaming platforms that process high-velocity data for real-time analytics and applications.
responsibilities: Develop real-time pipelines using Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink
Ensure low-latency and fault-tolerant streaming systems
Integrate streaming data with downstream analytics systems
Handle data ordering, deduplication, and windowing

skills_required.name: Expertise in Kafka, Flink, or Spark Streaming
Strong understanding of real-time data processing concepts
Programming in Scala, Java, or Python
